observations: Supported-activities documentation distinguishes CUDA timing from CUPTI device tracing when CUPTI is unavailable.
Use builtin profile context with CPU and supported CUDA activities; no custom callbacks, stacks, shapes, tensor values or trace export.
events() is queried only after context exit; retain unavailable CUDA event capture rather than inventing a kernel identity.
scope: Selected builtin profiler source identities and API excerpts (profile start/stop, events and supported activities); not a whole-module/native-library/driver audit or signed provenance.
